pr.title: Build the institutional trade system
pr.body:
## Scope

This draft PR implements the institutional Moral Trade system in three coherent layers:

### Beta 1 — transaction integrity
- mandates
- resource and bottleneck profiles
- counterfactual baselines
- confidential matching
- deal rooms
- multi-party obligations
- budget reservations
- risk review
- performance monitoring
- dispute states
- operator Deal Desk

### Beta 2 — repeatability
- institutional track record
- reusable templates
- framework agreements
- independent verifiers
- board packets
- structured reporting
- permission-aware Command integration

### Beta 3 — collective coordination
- institutional consortium trades
- moral-public-goods pools
- anchor and underwriter structures
- contribution and threshold governance
- advanced matching
- enterprise integration foundations

The implementation will preserve person-level authentication, represent organizations/programs/legal counterparties separately, enforce scoped authority and approvals, retain immutable versions and audit events, and avoid universal moral-impact scoring.

The temporary source-export workflow exists only to obtain the exact branch source for local implementation and verification. It will be removed before review completion.
